incident--noun.def: An event, usually an unpleasant or unusual one.
incident--noun.ex: Nobody was hurt in the incident.

leading--adj.def: Most important or most successful in a field.
leading--adj.ex: She is a leading expert on bees.
leading--adj.exTr: Arılar konusunda önde gelen bir uzman.

engaged--adj.def: Having promised to marry, or busy with something.

anger--noun.def: The strong feeling you have when something is unfair.
anger--noun.ex: His voice was full of anger.

sharp--adj.def: Having an edge that cuts easily, or sudden and great.
sharp--adj.ex: Use a sharp knife for the bread.
sharp--adj.exTr: Ekmek için keskin bir bıçak kullan.

shadow--verb.def: To follow someone closely and secretly.
shadow--verb.ex: A detective shadowed him for days.
shadow--verb.exTr: Bir dedektif onu günlerce takip etti.

wave--verb.def: To move your hand to greet someone or say goodbye.
wave--verb.ex: She waved from the train window.

sometime--adv.def: At a time that is not exactly stated.

bull--noun.def: The adult male of the cattle family.
bull--noun.ex: A bull stood in the field.

passion--noun.def: A very strong feeling or interest.

empire--noun.def: A group of countries ruled by one power.

hire--verb.def: To give someone a job, or to pay to use something.

device--noun.def: A small machine made for a particular job.

design--verb.def: To plan how something will look and work.

movement--noun.def: A change of position, or a group working for a cause.
movement--noun.ex: Any movement will hurt your back.

thunder--noun.def: The loud noise that follows lightning.

object--noun.def: A thing you can see and touch, or an aim.
object--noun.ex: A small metal object lay there.
object--noun.exTr: Orada küçük bir metal nesne duruyordu.

politics--noun.def: The activities of government and political parties.

alcohol--noun.def: Drinks such as wine and beer that can make you drunk.

prize--noun.def: Something given to the winner of a competition.

sports--adj.def: Relating to games and physical competition.
sports--adj.ex: He writes for a sports magazine.

debt--noun.def: Money that you owe to someone.
debt--noun.ex: They paid off the debt slowly.

wire--noun.def: A thin piece of metal used to carry electricity.
wire--noun.ex: A loose wire caused the fire.
wire--noun.exTr: Gevşek bir kablo yangına yol açtı.

circle--verb.def: To move around something in a ring.

approach--noun.def: A way of dealing with a problem.

normally--adv.def: In the usual way, or most of the time.

tank--noun.def: A large container for liquid, or an armoured vehicle.
tank--noun.ex: The water tank is almost empty.

authority--noun.def: The power to give orders, or an official body.
authority--noun.ex: Only the manager has that authority.

failure--noun.def: A lack of success, or when a machine stops working.

glory--noun.def: Great fame and honour won by an achievement.
glory--noun.ex: The team returned home in glory.

border--noun.def: The line between two countries or areas.
border--noun.ex: We crossed the border at dawn.

reputation--noun.def: The opinion people have about someone.
reputation--noun.ex: The restaurant has a fine reputation.

confidence--noun.def: The feeling that you or others can succeed.

beloved--adj.ex: He wrote about his beloved city.

mental--adj.def: Relating to the mind rather than the body.

secure--adj.def: Safe from danger, or firmly fixed.
secure--adj.ex: Keep your passport in a secure place.

sand--noun.def: The tiny grains that cover beaches and deserts.
sand--noun.ex: The children played in the sand.

emotional--adj.def: Relating to feelings, or showing them strongly.

setting--noun.def: The place where something happens, or a chosen level.
setting--noun.ex: Change the setting to a lower heat.
setting--noun.exTr: Ayarı daha düşük bir ısıya getir.

reward--noun.def: Something given in return for good work or help.
reward--noun.ex: There is a reward for the lost dog.

commit--verb.def: To do something wrong, or to promise yourself to something.

extraordinary--adj.def: Far beyond what is usual or expected.

opposite--adv.def: Facing something from the other side.

opposite--noun.def: A thing that is completely different from another.
opposite--noun.ex: Hot is the opposite of cold.

chat--noun.ex: I had a quick chat with the boss.

slip--noun.def: A small piece of paper, or a small mistake.
slip--noun.ex: He wrote it on a slip of paper.

slip--verb.def: To slide by accident and lose your balance.
slip--verb.ex: She slipped on the wet floor.

agreement--noun.def: An arrangement that two sides both accept.
agreement--noun.ex: They signed the agreement in Ankara.

solid--adj.def: Hard and firm, or strong and reliable.
solid--adj.ex: The table is made of solid oak.

district--noun.def: One part of a city or a country.
district--noun.ex: She grew up in a farming district.

gee--interj.def: An American exclamation of surprise or mild annoyance.

ignore--verb.def: To pay no attention to someone or something.

naturally--adv.def: As you would expect, or without being changed.

attempt--verb.def: To try to do something difficult.

guarantee--noun.def: A promise that something will happen or be repaired.
guarantee--noun.ex: The phone has a two-year guarantee.

policy--noun.def: A plan of action agreed by a government or company.
policy--noun.ex: The school changed its phone policy.

bow--noun.def: A weapon for shooting arrows, or a tied ribbon.
bow--noun.ex: He shot an arrow from his bow.

disaster--noun.def: A sudden event that causes great damage.
disaster--noun.ex: The flood was a national disaster.

identity--noun.def: Who a person is, or what makes a group different.

impressive--adj.def: So good that people admire it.

potential--noun.def: The ability to develop or succeed in the future.
potential--noun.ex: The young player has real potential.
potential--noun.exTr: Genç oyuncunun gerçek bir potansiyeli var.

delivery--noun.def: The act of bringing goods to a place.

advance--verb.def: To move forward, or to make progress.
advance--verb.ex: The army advanced towards the river.

teaching--noun.def: The job of a teacher, or an idea that is taught.
teaching--noun.ex: She left teaching after ten years.

dirt--noun.def: Dust or mud that makes things unclean.
dirt--noun.ex: His boots were covered in dirt.

whistle--noun.def: A small instrument that makes a high sound.

deny--verb.def: To say that something is not true.

unique--adj.def: The only one of its kind.

cruel--adj.def: Causing pain to others without caring.

behave--verb.def: To act in a particular way towards others.
